name: Ichijou Yuuichi
source: Husband of the heroine. He treats her roughly and takes it for granted that she has to rely on him and follow anything he says. On the other hand, he becomes meek and flattering when facing her younger sister who is also his boss at work.
translation: Husband of the heroine. He treats her roughly and takes it for granted that she has to rely on him and follow anything he says. On the other hand, he becomes meek and flattering when facing her younger sister who is also his boss at work.
